info.name: Alfonse's Smile
info.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice

descriptions.notStarted: I better go see Alfonse right now. I'm sure he's been dying to see me!
descriptions.inProgress: I got Alfonse Green exactly what he wanted, the Nependeath Juice.
descriptions.completed: I've never seen anyone so happy over a glass of juice as Alfonse Green was with his glass of Nependeath Juice.
